targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "perf")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${sh_flux})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => ${sb_flux})
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["item"] == "HeartbeatRspTime")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _field: r.serialboard_id }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
  |> yield(name: "mean")

list.definition:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT '${sb_id:csv}' AS expr
),
split_expr AS (
  SELECT r.expr, LTRIM(RTRIM(s.value)) AS value
  FROM raw r
  CROSS APPLY STRING_SPLIT(r.expr, ',') AS s
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN MIN(LTRIM(RTRIM(expr))) IN ('All') THEN 'true'
    ELSE STRING_AGG('r["serialboard_id"] == "' + value + '"', ' or ')
  END AS result
FROM split_expr;
list.name: sb_flux
